{{Quote|All the B'omarr want is that sacred scroll. You're in my way and must be removed.|Rath Kanaz|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Rath Kanaz''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for [[Hedon Istee]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateBountyHunter.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Rath Kanaz]]
{{Quote|The bounty hunter goes by the name of Rath Kanaz. I can tell you now that bounty hunters a very deceptive and cunning individuals. They may hurl some wild and baseless accusations to justify their actions. Don't listen to a word they say - it's all noncense [sic].|Hedon Istee|<ref name="SWG:AED" />}}
The actual NPC was named '''Rath Kana''', without the 'Z' in the last name. This article assumes that Kanaz is canon, as that was the name used in the quest dialogue.
